plan.primary: Mean across test subjects of outcome_history NLL minus evidence_history NLL; lower NLL is better.
plan.decision: At least 40 eligible subjects, mean gain >= 0.0005 nats/trial, and subject bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.
plan.threshold_rationale: A fixed practical screen around half the exploratory gain, not an established biological threshold.
plan.sampling: 60 reserved subjects, one latest standard biased session each; no replacements after QC.
plan.exclusions: Preset trial/easy-trial/accuracy gates; source-integrity errors exclude a session and are reported.
plan.no_tuning: No hyperparameter selection, retraining, threshold changes, or replacement cohort based on test outcomes.
plan.limits: Internal prospective freeze only; no external preregistration or committed-protocol claim.

cohort.selection: Hash-order subjects; latest exact standard biasedChoiceWorld session per subject; no outcome/QC filtering.
limits: Unseen relative to the inventoried local references, not a claim that no earlier fetch ever inspected them.
This is an internal prospective plan, not externally preregistered research.
No replacement of failed QC subjects based on behavioral results; assess prespecified cohort sufficiency.
